maya: quick async standup — onboarding llama3-tinyq: landed tokenizer patch, tests green locally but CI failing on kv warmup
sam: which CI error?
maya: runner shows kvcache mismatch at step 0 — snippet:
```
ERROR: kvcache seed mismatch
```
jin: seen that before. Prob nondet RNG in tokenization; I pushed a seed fix in draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/llm/pull/1234
sam: i'll merge a short patch to the eval harness today, linking infra PR shortly
sam: PR -> https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/432 (adds deterministic seeding + batching tweak)
eval-bot: eval report: model=llama3-tinyq variant=v2 | regressions=address-hallucinations(+2) | exact_match=-2.1% on promptset addr-synth
alex: QA flagged addr-synth hallucinations earlier. Prob introduced by recent quant tweak shifting rare-token logits
praveen: can we pin prod to v1 and canary v2 after fixes? I can schedule rollback window
maya: yes please — need infra approval for rollback window (2:00–3:00pm PT)
praveen: booked slot 14:10 PT in calendar
sam: opened rollback playbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback/235
sam: i'm reverting quant change in canary and will rerun the evals; will post results here
jin: also discovered spanish tokenizer edge-case (NFKC vs NFD) causing token splits; adding unit test now
maya: blockers: infra ok for rollback window, waiting on sam's revert to rerun eval harness, need prompt edits for addr-synth to reduce hallucinations
alex: for prompt edits try adding explicit 'do not invent addresses' guard and an extra verification step
maya: today: finalize prompt revisions, coordinate canary rollback, validate CI fix; ping me for pairing
eval-bot: created alert rule: eval.regressions.addr_synth >= 1 -> #eng-ml-alerts
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
